name: open_file
description: Open a document/image/video in its default application. target: approved absolute path, or empty for a picker.

name: open_folder
description: Open an approved folder. target: absolute path, standard folder name, or empty for a picker.

name: reveal_file
description: Reveal an approved file in Explorer. target: absolute path.

name: search_files
description: Search filenames only in user-approved directories. target: name query. Returns paths; never reads document contents.

name: get_file_information
description: Get size, extension and modification time of an approved file. target: absolute path.

name: open_website
description: Open an http/https URL after approval. target: full URL.

name: open_application
description: Launch an app from the user-approved application list. target: app ID from observations. No arguments or commands.

name: close_application
description: Request a shared window to close gracefully, with native confirmation. target: current window token. Never force-kills.

name: focus_window
description: Switch to the explicitly shared window. target: current window token.

name: get_active_window
description: Get foreground window title and app name. target: empty.

name: get_system_info
description: Get OS, architecture, CPU count and memory. target: empty. No username or network information.

name: take_screenshot
description: Ask the user to select and preview one screen/window snapshot for the next message. target: empty. Does not automatically upload.

name: click_mouse
description: One left click in a shared Notepad, Calculator or Paint window. target: JSON string {window:token,x:integer,y:integer}, coordinates relative to client area. Native confirmation required.

name: type_text
description: Type literal text in shared Notepad. target: JSON string {window:token,text:string}, at most 500 characters. Native confirmation required. No commands or key chords.

name: press_key
description: Press one navigation key in shared Notepad, Calculator or Paint. target: JSON string {window:token,key:string}; key is Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace, Left, Right, Up, Down, Home, End, PageUp or PageDown. Native confirmation required.

name: scroll_window
description: Scroll a shared Notepad, Calculator or Paint window. target: JSON string {window:token,steps:integer}, -5..5. Native confirmation required.

name: play_media
description: Play local audio with mpv. target: exact approved path, unique song name, or empty for picker. Confirm playback only after execution succeeds.

name: play_music
description: Alias of play_media.

name: search_music
description: Search the selected music library by name. target: song query.

name: search_media
description: Alias of search_music.

name: pause_media
description: Pause Misaki's player. target: empty.

name: resume_media
description: Resume Misaki's player. target: empty.

name: stop_media
description: Stop Misaki's player. target: empty.

name: next_track
description: Play next queued track. target: empty.

name: previous_track
description: Play previous queued track. target: empty.

name: set_volume
description: Set Misaki player volume. target: integer string 0..100.

name: get_playback_status
description: Read actual player state. target: empty.
